say:2:1131020001:1.text: It's all his fault! He swore before we set out that he knew where the Dusk Lord's treasure was hidden.
say:2:1131020001:1.source_cn: 都是我旁边这个家伙，出发之前信誓旦旦地和我说他知道残阳...
say:2:1131020001:1.male: It's all his fault! He swore before we set out that he knew where the Dusk Lord's treasure was hidden.
say:2:1131020001:1.female: It's all his fault! He swore before we set out that he knew where the Dusk Lord's treasure was hidden.

say:3:1131020002:1.text: Now, even with a map in hand, we're totally lost!
say:3:1131020002:1.source_cn: 现在倒好，看着地图也不知道路怎么走，我们俩连现在在哪里...
say:3:1131020002:1.male: Now, even with a map in hand, we're totally lost!
say:3:1131020002:1.female: Now, even with a map in hand, we're totally lost!

say:4:1131020003:1.text: Quit blaming me! It was all going fine until you said we should head south.
say:4:1131020003:1.source_cn: 少血口喷人！在你提议往南走之前，我可一点也没迷路。

choice_prompt:5:1131020003.text: Quit blaming me! It was all going fine until you said we should head south.
choice_prompt:5:1131020003.source_cn: 少血口喷人！在你提议往南走之前，我可一点也没迷路。

say:6:1131020004:1.text: No way! We've come so far. The treasure might be right in front of us! How can we turn around now?
say:6:1131020004:1.source_cn: 不行，我们都走了这么远了，说不定宝藏就在前面，哪能这时...
say:6:1131020004:1.male: No way! We've come so far. The treasure might be right in front of us! How can we turn around now?
say:6:1131020004:1.female: No way! We've come so far. The treasure might be right in front of us! How can we turn around now?

say:7:1131020005:1.text: We don't know how to get back anyway... it all looks the same out here...
say:7:1131020005:1.source_cn: 而且现在也找不到回去的路了……在这高原上，哪里看起来都一样。
say:7:1131020005:1.male: We don't know how to get back anyway... it all looks the same out here...
say:7:1131020005:1.female: We don't know how to get back anyway... it all looks the same out here...

say:8:1131020006:1.text: *sigh* We really need to think this through. Or perhaps your "extraordinary sense of direction" can lead us to the treasure.
say:8:1131020006:1.source_cn: 唉，还是先想想怎么办吧，或者祈祷你那“超乎寻常的方向感...

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 不如回到原点，重新走一遍？
